us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: United Airlines delays departures after 90-minute system outage
bullets: A United system outage delayed departing flights Monday.
The issue affected electronic weight-and-balance calculations.
United apologized to customers for the disruption.

articles.title: US adds third aircraft carrier to Middle East amid Iran war tensions
bullets: A third American carrier arrived in the Middle East.
The deployment expands US military options in the region.
The move follows new Iranian attacks on US-linked targets.

articles.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to begin Asia trip
bullets: Trump arrived in Manila for a three-day Asia trip.
He announced progress on a US-Thailand trade arrangement.
The trip includes economic and security diplomacy.

articles.title: Federal government conducts nationwide emergency alert test
bullets: A national emergency alert broadcast test was scheduled Tuesday.
Officials said recent outages showed no coordinated cyberattack evidence.
The test followed several high-profile technology disruptions.

articles.title: Education groups warn of US student visa and enrollment strain
bullets: Higher-education advocates warned of declining foreign-student interest.
Participation reportedly fell amid new policy uncertainty.
Groups said tougher fees could worsen enrollment pressures.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Iran fires drones at US radar facility in Bahrain
bullets: Iran launched drones at a US radar facility in Bahrain.
AP reported it was Iran’s third recent strike there.
The attack followed a roughly two-month lull.

articles.title: Trump plans Asia talks with Xi, Putin and possible Kim meeting
bullets: Trump’s Asia trip includes planned talks with Xi and Putin.
He said Ukraine would be discussed during the meetings.
A possible meeting with Kim Jong Un remained under discussion.

articles.title: Malaysia-France rare earths venture set for early 2027 launch
bullets: Macron said operations are due to begin in early 2027.
Malaysia and France elevated ties to a strategic partnership.
The project focuses on mining and processing rare earths.

articles.title: Nuclear safety groups warn over Russian attacks on Ukraine energy sites
bullets: International bodies cited rising nuclear-safety risks in Ukraine.
They linked concerns to attacks on energy infrastructure.
Reuters reported the warning in a joint statement.

articles.title: Japan protests reported Russian airspace breach
bullets: Japan protested a reported Russian airspace violation.
The episode added to regional security tensions.
The story appeared in global news roundups Tuesday.

articles.title: Cyclone Akvan expected to intensify before Andhra coast approach
bullets: IMD tracked a Bay of Bengal system intensifying rapidly.
Indian Express reported a possible Andhra coast impact on November 20.
Authorities monitored storm strength and projected landfall risks.

articles.title: IMD warns Bay of Bengal depression may become severe cyclonic storm
bullets: IMD said the system was moving north-northwestward.
It was forecast to strengthen over the west-central Bay of Bengal.
The advisory covered conditions through November 17.

articles.title: Modi attends ASEAN-India and East Asia meetings in Manila
bullets: Modi visited Manila from November 16 to 18.
He attended ASEAN-India and East Asia Summit meetings.
He said India’s development and ASEAN prosperity were closely linked.

articles.title: Quad leaders meet as Asia diplomacy intensifies
bullets: The Indian Express reported Quad leaders were meeting Tuesday.
The talks came before US-Russia-China diplomacy in Asia.
China was a key strategic backdrop to the meeting.

articles.title: Prince and Princess of Wales travel to Mumbai for Earthshot Prize
bullets: Kate joined William for the India trip.
The Earthshot Prize Awards Night was scheduled November 17.
The visit centered on climate and environmental innovation.

bullets: AP said Nvidia led another technology-stock selloff.
The weakness helped drag major US indexes lower.
Investors awaited Nvidia results after leadership turmoil.

bullets: The Dow fell 739.38 points Monday.
The decline equaled a 1.4% drop to 51,608.17.
Tech weakness weighed on broader sentiment.

articles.title: Semiconductor stocks tumble as AI trade unwinds
bullets: Axios cited a 5.3% drop in major chip stocks.

bullets: Market trackers showed Tesla among notable decliners.

AI and megacap volatility pressured sentiment.

articles.title: Apple remains key S&P 500 support despite market weakness
bullets: Yahoo Finance reported Apple had added heavily to the S&P 500 in 2026.
Futures slipped ahead of Nvidia earnings Tuesday.

business.label: Business

articles.title: Warren Buffett donates about $5.5 billion to family foundations
bullets: Buffett pledged Berkshire Hathaway shares worth about $5.5 billion.

The money will go to his family’s foundations.

articles.title: DoorDash-Instacart deal draws antitrust attention

Reuters reported scrutiny in a US domestic-news summary.
The deal targets the competitive grocery-delivery market.

bullets: Reuters reported Kalshi was in talks to raise fresh capital.

The move followed scrutiny after Jensen Huang’s departure.
